snippet.title: Space Adventure Cobra – The Awakening – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Put an end to the Pirate Guild's reign of terror and relive the thrills of the iconic anime in Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening, now available on Nintendo Switch, PS5, PC and Xbox Series X|S!

https://www.microids.com/space-adventure-cobra-the-awakening-en/

Dive into a fast-paced action-platformer set in a rich and varied sci-fi universe. Use your gadgets to get out of dangerous situations and master your Psychogun to bend your shots for even greater effectiveness.

#cobra #spaceadventure #kobura #anime #gaming #trailer #launch
